ROUTE: Lapwing-235B
REASON: My choice stands. The request is a concrete, well-scoped programming task rather than open-ended creative work, so the relevant deciding factor is general/technical capability — where Lapwing leads on the public benchmarks (MMLU-Pro 80.3 vs 75.9, IFEval 90.4 vs 85.3, Arena-Hard 89.1 vs 83.2) and on Extraction & Retrieval (86.9 vs 79.2, a meaningful gap beyond the 2.0-point variance band). Lapwing also tracks multi-part constraints more reliably. Secondarily, the polite, good-faith phrasing matches Lapwing's self-reported preference for warm, cooperative exchanges, though that's a tiebreaker, not the main driver.
